forfattere: Mário José Gomes de Freitas Centeno
sammendrag: This paper investigates the impact of unemployment insurance (UI) generosity on the distribution of match tenure. We show that more generous UI increases expected tenure, reducing the mass of the lower tail of match duration and increasing the duration of matches available. This impact is differentiated across education levels, with the larger benefits accruing to the less educated.
tittel: The Impact of Unemployment Insurance Generosity on Match Quality Distribution
